==Description==
This plugin provides advanced support for specifying use tasks as user requirements, especially new sub tasks. Thus it consist of two views shown an described on the images and text below.

===Tutorial for users===
Create a new element "UserTask" from the package "usertask" in UNICASE.  

[http://unicase.googlecode.com/svn/trunk/other/heidelberg/plugin-resources/UserTaskMain.png] 

This view provides a form to specify standard values for a user requirement. Including the frequency the user tasks occurs, and the start and end trigger for the user task. On the upper left it contains an element which provides information about the sub-tasks.  Sub-tasks are more fine grained elements a user task consists of. E.g. for the user task “make a pizza” there are sub-tasks for “make dough”, “make covering” and “bake pizza”. Sub-tasks can be created and edited with the second form which can be activated by the tab element “Sub Tasks” on the bottom of the User Task View. 

[http://unicase.googlecode.com/svn/trunk/other/heidelberg/plugin-resources/UserTaskSubTasks.png] 

A sub-task consists of a unique name and a description. The table based form shown in figure 2 provides the capabilities for sub-task creation. With the help of the buttons on the upper right side it is possible to create, remove and reorder sub-tasks. In addition a sub-task can contain Problems and Variants (elements on the 2nd hierarchy level). At which problems (yellow symbol/ button) describe typical problems that may occur during the respective sub-task including an example solution. Variants (blue symbol/ button) are variants of the sub-task, e.g. in the “make covering” pizza example from above a variant could be “make vegetarian covering”.  If created all elements (sub-tasks, variants, problems) have 3 editable text fields (Name, Description and Example of Solution).
